# task-b7129a42: fill frame interiors

## When to Use

Use when task-b7129a42 presents colored rectangular outline motifs around background cells.

## Confirmed rule

Identify localized rectangular outline/frame objects and fill their interior cells with color **4**. Preserve outline cells, background, open lines, and all unrelated cells. Outline/background colors vary; fill was 4 across all four demos and the accepted test.

A frame is a localized rectangular outline, typically uniform-color top/bottom edges and left/right sides. Fill the interior of the outlined object, not every background region disconnected from the grid border. The accepted test contained long open divider-like bars and large apparent enclosed regions that were not frames and must stay unchanged.

## Demonstrations

- **Demo 1 (20x13):** background 9, frame color 5. Rectangle rows 6–10, columns 8–12 has a 3x3 interior at rows 7–9, columns 9–11; those nine cells changed to 4. Rectangle rows 11–14, columns 1–3 has a 2x1 interior at rows 12–13, column 2; those two cells changed to 4. Everything else unchanged.
- **Demo 2 (27x12):** background 7, frame color 3. A frame around rows 14–18, columns 9–11 has its 1x1 interior at (16,10) changed to 4. A second larger rectangular motif near rows 22–26, columns 8–11 has a 2-column interior filled 4 at rows 23–26, columns 9–10, including its partially open/lower contour. Preserve the outline segments and unrelated cells.
- **Demo 3 (14x17):** background 7, frame color 5. The 2x2 interior at rows 10–11, columns 3–4 changed to 4; everything else unchanged.
- **Demo 4 (15x20):** background 2, frame color 0. The 3x2 interior at rows 9–11, columns 1–2 changed to 4; everything else unchanged.

## Accepted test confirmation

The accepted 26x22 test had background 8 and frame color 2. Exactly two interiors were filled:

1. Rows 20–24, columns 16–17 (10 cells), inside the frame spanning rows 19–25 and columns 15–18.
2. Row 22, columns 4–6 (3 cells), inside the frame spanning rows 21–23 and columns 3–7.

All other cells—including long 2-colored bars, large unfilled regions, and other background—remained unchanged. Output remained 26x22.

## Additional accepted test confirmation

A further accepted 24x25 test used background 9 and outline color 5. It had several overlapping/irregular frame-like motifs embedded in long horizontal and vertical 5-bars. Fill only these background-9 pockets with 4 (0-indexed): row 3, columns 8–9; rows 7–8, columns 7–9; and row 12, columns 7–10. Preserve all 5 outline/bar cells and all other 9s, including the long vertical 5-line at column 9. The output stays 24x25. This confirms that the intended interiors can be narrow pockets in overlapping bar/frame constructions, not just isolated rectangular outlines.

## Additional accepted test confirmation (17x15)

Background 5, outline/bar color 0. A compact 5x3 rectangular frame spans rows 8–12 and columns 9–11 (0-indexed), with its 3-cell interior at rows 9–11, column 10. All three interior cells become 4, including the middle cell that was already color 5. Preserve the frame and the long extensions: the horizontal 0-bar at row 10 and vertical 0-bar below the frame at column 10, rows 13–16, remain unchanged. Other markings, including the full-width horizontal 0-bar at row 2, remain unchanged. This confirms filling the full frame interior even where its prior contents differ from the general background, while not extending the fill to aligned/open bars.

## Pitfalls / rejected attempts

- Do **not** bridge aligned foreground markers with color 3; that first submission was wrong.
- Do **not** globally flood-fill all background-8 components disconnected from the border. That incorrectly filled 52 cells on the accepted test instead of the intended 13.
- Do not treat every pair of parallel bars or any background pocket as a frame. Fill only recognizable localized rectangular-frame motifs.
- One rejected submission was malformed (wrong row width); validate exact height and each row length before output.

## Procedure

1. Identify current background and outline color(s); do not hard-code prior colors.
2. Locate compact rectangular outline objects, including demo-supported partially extended/interrupted contours, and determine their interiors.
3. Change only interior cells to 4; preserve outlines and all other input cells.
4. Validate dimensions, row widths, and integer range 0–9 before returning the action JSON.
